secrets.text: The Post Road Company slipped him money and leaned on him to send the scouting party out three days early.
secrets.reveal_when: Produce the Company ledger, or notice his guilty conscience and press him on it

cares: his late wife (the town's last surveyor)

secrets.text: Locked in his back room is the old fog-road map his wife left behind; she died in the fog, and her survey book is still in Mossbarrow.
secrets.reveal_when: Tell him you mean to go into the fog to find someone

cares: her younger brother Milo coming home alive

secrets.text: Milo's charm is sewn into her sleeve, with the scouting party's route stitched across it.
secrets.reveal_when: Promise to go and find Milo

secrets.text: He has taken money from the One-Eyed Tiger's men and kept lookout for the bandits.
secrets.reveal_when: Notice him dodging and press him, or find his betting slips at the camp

cares: nobody in town dying during the fog season
keeping the Company and the guild from dragging the town into their fight over the north road

secrets.text: Every year someone fails to come back from the night the fog withdraws, and the Town Office never records it.
secrets.reveal_when: Ask about the fog-withdrawing nights of years past

npcs.name: Old Fish (ferryman at the docks)
traits: afraid of the lights in the fog

cares: a good fare for a boatload

secrets.text: He has seen lights in the fog strung out in a line towards Mossbarrow — the scouting party's lanterns.

cares: getting along the north road ahead of everyone else

secrets.text: The caravan's ledger records the money paid to Heron.
secrets.reveal_when: Steal the ledger, or get her drunk

cares: holding the ore track along the north road
keeping the Company from reaching the north road first

secrets.text: He was once a miner in Jadestone; when the mine closed, he led his people out to live off this ore track.
secrets.reveal_when: Bring up the Jadestone mines, or show him a Miners' Guild badge
